text:
Ashwin Patel: kicking off FP8 kernel enablement probe on h100-canary-2. model=atlas-13b, route=longctx-eval, mixed H100/L40S profiles. seeing intermittent NaNs in warmup and tiny accuracy drift on lm-eval. anyone seen this pattern?
Maria Chen: which kernel build/revision? the sat-clamp patch landed last week.
Ben Ortiz: what quant path? FP8 native or hybrid fallback to FP16 when scale>threshold?
Ashwin Patel: running build fp8-kernel-2026-03-17, native FP8 path. small fallback policy disabled for canary to stress the kernel. sample logs below.
Ashwin Patel: ```
[2026-03-17 14:12:08] run_id=12 step=34 seq=2048 loss=nan kv_evicted=true scale=1.23e-03 fp8_clip=inf
kernel: fp8_v2_gemm.c:142 assert(!isnan(out)) failed
stackframe: runtime/kernel_fp8_v2 +0x1f4
```
Kevin Zhou: looks like accumulation overflow - scale blew up then clip->inf. did you enable per-channel scaling and the new range clamp?
Anna Schmidt: also check tiling config for L40S path. we saw a long-sequence tiling mismatch that only showed up when seq>1500; behaviour is subtle.
Maria Chen: agree. we had a similar spike on L40S where KV eviction + prefix fusion increased local scale variance and produced NaNs. workaround was soft-fallback to fp16 for routes where seq_mean>1200.
Ben Ortiz: FYI AWQ/int8 bakeoff notes: AWQ gave ~0.7% eval delta vs fp16 but very good cost savings. doesn't help FP8 kernel instability though.
Ashwin Patel: plan: 1) repro deterministically on single H100 with seed=42, seq=2048; 2) enable FP8_PER_CHANNEL=1 and sat_clamp patch; 3) add defensive clip in kernel to count NaNs not crash; 4) shadow route small fraction to fallback path while we debug. starting step 1 now.
Maria Chen: I can attach perfmon traces and nvprof counters for the failing run. will upload to the thread.
Ashwin Patel: please do, perf counters would help confirm accumulation peaks.
perf-bot: uploaded /artifacts/4771234567/perf/h100-run12-trace.tar.gz
Ben Ortiz: if you want a quick mitigation, roll a routing rule in Console to send seq>1024 traffic to fp16 variant and keep seq<=1024 on fp8. quick A/B.
Ashwin Patel: doing a 3% shadow for longctx now, will increase to 10% if stable. tagging Kevin for kernel patch review. @Kevin Zhou can you look at the extra clip guard?
Kevin Zhou: will take a look. quick thought: add a saturating accumulation op in the kernel and export debug counter (nan_count) to console metrics. small overhead but helps root cause.
Ashwin Patel: adding nan_count metric to the rollout metrics. also creating an eval job to compare lm-eval and rouge for fp8 vs fp16 after the patch.
Maria Chen: note — when you repro, try both single-stream and multi-stream workload. the race/eviction pattern only reproduced under concurrent KV writes for us.
Ashwin Patel: good call. running both. will update with traces and a short perf/accuracy summary. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout h100-canary-2: traffic 3% -> 10% completed :rocket:
Anna Schmidt: thanks, keep us posted. if the NaN rate >0 for 10 minutes, toggle rollback policy to soft-fallback automatically.
Ashwin Patel: will do. starting bisect now, will post results in this thread.
